title: Zechariah 1: chapter overview
paragraphs: An exhortation to repentance.
A vision of the ministry of angels.
The security of the Jews and the destruction of their enemies.

outline.text: An exhortation to repentance.
A vision of the ministry of angels.
The security of the Jews and the destruction of their enemies.

context: This prophecy is suitable to all, as the scope is to reprove for sin, and threaten God's judgments against the impenitent, and to encourage those that feared God, with assurances of the mercy God had in store for his church, and especially of the coming of the Messiah, and the setting up his kingdom in the world.
attribution: Matthew Henry, Concise Commentary (public domain). Historical Protestant interpretation; other traditions may read these passages differently.
